prompt:
Create ONE native transparent RGBA PNG refined natural-ink2.5D fighting-game creature sprite atlas of WANDERER from METAL GEAR SURVIVE2018, as faithful to the supplied original creature references as possible. First images are the actual original appearance authority; LAST image is only line/painting and sixteen-pose atlas STYLE/SPACING. NEVER copy Armstrong's identity, face, shirt, tie, muscles or human head. This is a dark crystalline non-human enemy from the released game, not a cyborg costume, generic fantasy monster or cute zombie.
IDENTITY AND ANATOMY: Original standard2018 human-derived Wanderer, NOT armoured and NOT Bomber. Grey exposed bare human torso with black crystalline deposits at shoulders/forearms. Head entirely replaced/covered by irregular black crystal cluster with ONE long angled red translucent pointed crystal. No visible regular human face, eyes or hair. Black charcoal straight trousers, black belt and plain dark shoes. Exactly two bare humanoid arms and two legs. Match slender ordinary human body proportions from licensed sculpture; no stylised demon armour.
SOURCE QUALIFICATION: Canonical shirtless appearance and trousers supported by official gameplay + licensed Gecco sculpture; pose motion/rear occlusion is authored adaptation.
FACING: all16 creature bodies and forward actions independently drawn facing SCREEN RIGHT. Preserve anatomical sides and asymmetric crystal deposits. Do not mirror another completed atlas. No ordinary face where crystalline growth replaces the head.
STRICT ATLAS: square page, exactly4equalcolumns x4equalrows, exactly16 separate complete connected head-to-feet figures. At least45fullytransparentpixels outer border and40transparentpixels between figures. One figure in each cell; figure maximum~220pixels high and225pixels wide within~320pixel cell, including all crystals/head/hands/feet. Every head-tip and foot/hand complete. All poses consistent bodily scale. Compact bent-knee kicks and folded KO; long appendages remain folded so figures stay inside cells. Each figure is one connected silhouette. No disconnected crystal shards, rubble, drops or detached limbs.
EXACT ROW-MAJOR POSES: row1col1 neutral stalking stand, row1col2 compact guard, row1col3 walk stride A, row1col4 walk stride B; row2col1 crouching guard, row2col2 attack windup, row2col3 active short reaching swipe, row2col4 low bent-knee attack; row3col1 grapple reach, row3col2 compact heavy body lunge, row3col3 crouched resource/reset motion, row3col4 overhead guard; row4col1 recovering stand, row4col2 hit recoil, row4col3 curled full-body prone KO, row4col4 kneeling getup.
True alpha0 background and all gutters. No labels, digits, grid, ground shadow, scenery, particles, attack effects, glowing halo, external muzzleflash, explosion or extra people. The attached red crystal can be intrinsically luminous, but NO external glow or particles outside body. Mutant anatomy only; no new equipment, firearm, armour plates or human face. Row4col3 knockout includes complete head-to-feet silhouette and both legs. Row3col3 reset and all crouches retain whole body. Body connected, native source pixels, no resizing/cropping/processing of the supplied sources. Highest useful native output resolution; 16actual independently authored poses, not repeated sprite clones.
